1: I am afraid that the people who stand around me in sport will sooner or later leave.
2: When work with a coach comes to an end, it takes me a long time to find my feet.
3: I lack the certainty that someone will back me even in a bad spell.

50: I will not accept help even when I need it, because I would feel incapable.

52: I am more afraid of injury than is usual in my sport.

56: I am afraid of losing control at the decisive moment.
